title: The best alarm app I’ve used
body:
Alarmy is honestly one of the most effective alarm apps I’ve tried. The missions make it much harder to simply turn off the alarm and go back to sleep, which is exactly what I need.

I especially like how customizable the alarms are and how the different missions keep waking up from feeling repetitive. The app is easy to use, reliable, and has genuinely helped me become more consistent with waking up on time.

There are a few features that feel a little too restricted behind the premium subscription, but overall, Alarmy is a great app and definitely worth trying if you struggle with getting out of bed.

Highly recommended! 🙌

Uninstalling this for now, might come back if this gets fixed.

title: my battery could’ve exploded.
body:
It took me 2.5 hours before I finally woke up. When I checked my phone, the alarm was still vibrating nonstop and the ringtone failed to play. What worried me the most was that the phone had already overheated badly, and I couldn’t even stop the alarm with the side buttons. I only managed to shut it down after putting it in the fridge. If I hadn’t woken up when I did, it honestly felt like the phone could have exploded.

I use Alarmy because the iOS alarm just isn’t reliable.. it failed to wake me up at the right time multiple times. But after a week, even Alarmy started doing the same. So now, before going to sleep, I test it to see if it will play at max volume. Still, I honestly don’t know what to do anymore.

title: An alarm that actually works!
body:
As an honor student with many responsibilities, I often sleep late, leading to oversleep. Then I found Alarmy, and at the risk of sounding like early morning infomercials, I finally found my solution!

Literally "solution," as I use - and love - the Math mode. Set to Hard difficulty, I can wake up to a challenge of my mental capacities. I get to be awake enough to think, while also improving my mental arithmetic skills!

The other modes are also fun, though I don't use them to be honest.

Overall, this is a great app I never knew I needed.
